purpose: Rex process budgets and terminal restoration; not release timing benchmarks

modern_agents.method: Four sessions, one unnamed tab and four panes per session (three agents and one shell); each Rex CLI process sleeps 15ms to model process/connection setup (individual RPC latency within Lua is not simulated). Real fzf in a PTY; preview disabled. switch_ms measures Enter until the fixture receives the validated switch request; selection_ms measures Enter until process exit, including target validation, focus/switch and state updates. The first run has empty history; later runs reuse it. RSS sums the picker and its descendants; CPU is the idle CPU-time delta, excluding the Python wrapper. This does not measure live app rendering or peak startup memory.
